## Summary / Resumo

<!-- EN: What problem does this PR solve and why now? -->
<!-- PT-BR: Qual problema esta PR resolve e por que agora? -->

## Scope / Escopo

<!-- EN: Describe the concrete changes (files, workflows, templates, docs). -->
<!-- PT-BR: Descreva as mudanças concretas (arquivos, workflows, templates, docs). -->

## Risk and Rollback / Risco e Rollback

<!-- EN: Operational risk, blast radius, and rollback path. -->
<!-- PT-BR: Risco operacional, impacto e caminho de rollback. -->

## Validation / Validação

- [ ] `make check` executed (or equivalent lightweight validation)
- [ ] Docs updated in both languages when applicable (`docs/en` and `docs/pt-br`)
- [ ] Affected workflows/manifests reviewed for least privilege and safe defaults
- [ ] Rollback plan documented

## Change Type / Tipo de Mudança

- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] CI/CD or GitHub workflow
- [ ] Backstage template / Golden Path
- [ ] GitOps / Argo CD manifests
- [ ] Security-related change

## Final Checklist / Checklist Final

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or tokens in files/history
- [ ] Conventional Commits used
- [ ] Ownership references updated when applicable (`catalog-info.yaml`, `CODEOWNERS`)
- [ ] ADR updated (required for architectural changes)
